scope: DXF INSERT callback placement conversion when dxfRW::read explicitly requests applyExtrusion; no physical-source or support claim

authority.title: Autodesk INSERT (DXF)
rules: Group code 10 is the INSERT insertion point in OCS, including its X, Y and Z coordinates.
Group code 210 is the optional extrusion direction, defaulting to (0, 0, 1).

authority.title: Autodesk Object Coordinate Systems (DXF)
authority.rule: The OCS basis is computed from the extrusion normal using the arbitrary-axis algorithm.

behavior: DRW_Insert::applyExtrusion converts the INSERT basePoint from OCS to WCS with the existing arbitrary-axis helper only when group 210 was explicitly present.
processInsert invokes the conversion only for dxfRW::read(..., applyExtrusion=true); the default false option retains the parsed OCS point.
The local INSERT angle and extrusion normal remain available to consumers; attached ATTRIB points continue to use their own existing conversion path.

generatedControl.adjacentControls: The same control continues to verify TEXT and INSERT-owned ATTRIB insertion/alignment conversion, OCS normals and local text angles.
generatedControl.fixtureDisposition: Generated in a temporary directory by the test and deleted; no DWG/DXF fixture committed.

limitations: Generated parser/callback controls only; no physical producer or paired-source evidence was used.
No native LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD or other consumer placement check was performed.
The control does not qualify full block-frame orientation, MINSERT array spacing, whole-document output, or 3D rendering.
